checks.name: no two hit areas overlap at 24px (adjacent SVG controls, pager links, a checkbox and buttons, stacked tag links)
a click on an SVG control lands on the control itself, with its own hover (nothing covers it)
a click on the ring around an SVG control, outside its box, activates the control
SVG controls with room on one side reach 24px; the one between them takes its half of each gap
a link that clips its own content is hit on its own box (hover works) and around it
a click on the ring around a link, outside its box, follows the link
a link stretched over its card by the page's own ::after keeps the whole card as its target
a button whose margin: auto the page overrides with a more specific rule stays where it was
a button centred by margin: auto in a media query stays centred when its container changes
a small button added 3px from one added earlier: their hit areas keep clear of each other
